Alias for UCRS.4a

Source: R/ucedergreen.R
uml3a.Rd

uml3a is an alias for UCRS.4a.

Usage

uml3a(names = c("b", "d", "e", "f"), ...)

Arguments

names

a vector of character strings giving the names of the parameters.

...

additional arguments passed to ucedergreen.

See also

UCRS.4a
